title: ObjectZoneList
description: zone.object-zone-list@1 (PLANNED; ADR-031 amendment 2026-10-02): the answer of GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/zones on OpenVibe.Zone (capability zone.zone.list), filtered by zone.object-zone-list-query@1. Zones come oldest first, the environment's default zone before the others. Deleted zones are listed only with include_deleted=true. contracts.zones.checkObjectZoneList also checks each zone's identity. More fields may be added.
